_comment: THE BOOTSTRAP INPUT for the authoritative control state (AUTONOMY-STATE-1B, accepted A+ memo §12).
The wsf-control-writer App reads this file ONLY when its protected ref (STATE_REF in gitstate.mjs, now
wsf-control-state-2) does not exist. It then writes line 1 of that ledger: a schema v2 bootstrap, source =
authorizedBy (the comment that authorized Step 5), authority class manual, rule MANUAL. It imports CURRENT
state as found at asOf, never history: a packet's earlier transitions are not replayed.
FRESHNESS (fails closed): asOf must be at most 6 hours before the run and not in the future, or the run
reports bootstrap-stale and writes nothing. canonical.operationalMain is NOT carried here: the writer
derives it from the commit it runs (main at run time). The integrator refreshes asOf and every packet,
worker, staging and development field to equal the human CURRENT, in the reviewed change that lands
RECOVERY: wsf-control-state-2 supersedes wsf-control-state, whose first bootstrap (run 50) imported this
file 28 hours stale. The writer refuses unless the predecessor holds only its bootstrap and the App's
set-shadow-surface line, names it in the new bootstrap's supersedes field, and reuses its shadow comment.
Contract pins: every entry of contractPaths is pinned at the commit the writer runs from on its
bootstrap run. A later writer version must be pinned by a recorded set-contracts decision before it

AUTONOMY-STATE-1B.label: Serial step 5: authoritative control state, App writer, bootstrap and shadow reconcile
